title: Auxiliary Power Unit Operating Limitations
abstract: Flight crew limitations for auxiliary power unit operation, covering the start and operating altitude envelopes, the bleed extraction limits and the restriction on continuous ground running.

sections.purpose: States the operating limitations for the auxiliary power unit that the flight crew must observe, including altitude envelopes and extraction limits.
sections.description: The auxiliary power unit has separate altitude envelopes for starting and for continued operation, and the starting envelope is the lower of the two. Above the starting altitude the unit may continue to run if it was already running, but a start may not be attempted. Bleed extraction for air conditioning and for engine starting is limited by altitude, and simultaneous electrical and bleed extraction at the upper end of the envelope is restricted. On the ground the unit may be run continuously, but operators whose ground infrastructure obliges them to run it for extended periods should be aware that the limitation on continuous running is set by the mounting and duct temperatures rather than by the unit itself, and that the maintenance programme assumes an average utilisation. Extended ground running is permitted but is recorded, because the inspection intervals for the installation are driven by running hours and not by flight hours.
sections.crew_procedure: Confirm the aircraft altitude against the starting envelope before requesting a start in flight. Do not attempt a start above the starting altitude even if the unit is available on the page. Observe the bleed extraction limits for the current altitude and do not select simultaneous electrical and bleed extraction above the stated level. Record extended ground running in the technical log so that the installation inspection interval can be tracked against running hours.
sections.limitation_note: Start altitude: not above the stated flight level. Operating altitude: not above the stated flight level. Bleed extraction: limited by altitude as tabulated; simultaneous electrical and bleed extraction not permitted above the stated level. Continuous ground running: permitted, and to be recorded, because the installation inspection interval is driven by running hours.

type_data.crew_action: Observe the start and operating altitude envelopes and the bleed extraction limits; record extended ground running.
